policy: These sources MUST be attempted every run. A run that produces no receipt for a required source (or a receipt with result_status NOT_SEARCHED) FAILS the run — silent skipping is a defect, not a degraded lane. This is enforced in code by pipeline._enforce_required_sources and tested; it is not prose.

required.note: LinkedIn 'top applicant' collection via read-only surf capture or --linkedin-evidence; never platform automation.
Indeed automation hits captcha; requires human-supplied results-page capture.
No public API — browser capture from hiddenjobs.dev is mandatory, always.
SAM.gov active opportunities; API 404s so browser capture is the channel.
Deep client-services research over candidate mandates (document extraction, agentic pipelines, compliance, Buffalo prospects). Mandatory, no exceptions.

rule: A required source may legitimately report FEED_DOWN/AUTH_REQUIRED with a receipt (honest failure). It may NOT be absent and may NOT be NOT_SEARCHED. Absence or NOT_SEARCHED fails the run.
api_website_fallback_rule: NON-NEGOTIABLE, 100% of the time (Graham 2026-08-06): if a source has NO working API, OR its API path fails (non-2xx / FEED_DOWN / AUTH_FAILED / INVALID_RESPONSE), the skill MUST capture from the source website via read-only browser. A bare API-failure or api-absent receipt is a DEFECT. Enforced by pipeline._enforce_api_website_fallback: a source flagged api_failure_requires_browser that lacks a *_website / human-supplied browser-capture receipt FAILS the run.
